footnotes: Approximately 7.8B shares, including 100% of Musk's holdings, remain locked beyond one year (~60% of shares outstanding); Musk's unlock (6/12/27) carries no early-release provision. The cumulative total above (102.4% of shares outstanding) exceeds 100% because the 424B4's lock-up table discloses 'up to X million shares' under alternative, conditional scenarios. It is a filing-disclosure convention, not a reconciliation error.

The Unlock Schedule tracks only Class A and Class B common stock (13,159.2M shares) as post-IPO lock-up agreements expire. It excludes the Anysphere and EchoStar/Spectrum share issuances (separate M&A-specific lock-up terms) and excludes unexercised options/unvested RSUs (not outstanding shares). The 14,461.4M diluted share count used in the per-share valuation includes all of these items which is why the two totals differ.
